canonical_statement: For a probability space and a measure-preserving transformation T, the Cesaro averages (1/N) sum_{k=0}^{N-1} f composed with T^k of every f in L2 converge in L2 to the orthogonal projection of f onto the closed subspace of T-invariant L2 functions.
domain_and_universes: A probability measure space (Omega, Sigma, mu); a measurable, mu-measure-preserving endomorphism T; f in L2(mu); convergence in the L2 norm.
ordered_binders: (f : Lp E 2 mu), provisionally E = Real
hypotheses: f is an L2 equivalence class
conclusion: The finite Cesaro averages of the Koopman iterates converge in L2 norm to the orthogonal projection onto the fixed-point subspace.

alternate_encodings.target: contraction form for a bounded linear operator U on a Hilbert space
alternate_encodings.relationship: The Koopman operator induced by T is an isometry; the operator theorem implies the frozen measure-theoretic claim.
alternate_encodings.checked_witness: none; candidate transport deferred to statement and obligation phases

alternate_encodings.target: limit characterized as conditional expectation onto the invariant sigma-algebra
alternate_encodings.relationship: Expected equivalent formulation under the standard identification of invariant functions.
alternate_encodings.checked_witness: none; candidate transport deferred to later phases

degenerate_cases: N = 0 is excluded by indexing averages with positive N. The identity transformation yields the constant sequence f. Non-ergodic transformations are included; the limit is a projection, not necessarily the constant integral of f.
